The '''Langoonans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Langoona]], located within [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The species was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who favored them until the Langoonans unsuccessfully [[Langoonan rebellion|rebelled]]. This resulted in the Langoonans being stripped of all technology and almost being driven to [[Death/Legends|extinction]], with only small numbers kept alive as prey for Hutt [[Hunting/Legends|safaris]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Langoonans were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Their anatomy allowed them to craft masks.<ref name="RD" />

==Society and culture==
The Langoonans lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Langoona]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> within the [[Langoona system/Legends|Langoona system]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. Their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] included warm [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and habitable islands, upon which some Langoonans created objects known as [[Langoonan deathmask|deathmasks]]. These deathmasks were decorated with semi-precious [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]] and inlaid with [[Silver/Legends|silver]], [[Gold/Legends|gold]], [[Platinum/Legends|platinum]], and iridescent shells from the ocean.<ref name="RD" />

The Langoonans lived as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species and served them well enough to become a favored slave species among their masters. This situation changed, however, after the Langoonans unsuccessfully attempted to [[Langoonan rebellion|rebel]] against the Hutts, at which point their society was stripped of technology. The small Langoonan population that survived was preserved by the Hutts for use in safaris, where they [[Hunting/Legends|hunted]] the slave species as prey.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:Durga_LoNH.png|thumb|right|220px|Durga the Hutt considered Langoonan deathmasks a treasure.]]
The Langoonans' homeworld was considered part of Hutt Space as early as [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]]. The natives were, at some stage, enslaved by the Hutts, who controlled the area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in which the Langoona [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located. After pleasing the Hutts sufficiently to become considered a favored species, the Langoonans rebelled against their masters, unsuccessfully. The Hutts drove the Langoonans to the edge of [[Death/Legends|extinction]] and stripped them of all their technology. The master species then maintained a small population of Langoonans for use in safaris.<ref name="TEA" />

Langoonan deathmasks were considered valuable pieces of art by [[Durga Besadii Tai]], head of the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. Durga gave one mask as a gift to [[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron]], head of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] kajidic, as a sign that he intended to kill [[Gender/Legends|her]].<ref name="RD" /> Langoona was still considered part of Hutt Space by [[137 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Langoonans were first mentioned in the [[1998]] novel ''[[Rebel Dawn]]'', the final installment of [[Star Wars: The Han Solo Trilogy|''The Han Solo Trilogy'']], written by [[A. C. Crispin]]. The story does not mention the species by name but describes them as the natives of Langoona.<ref name="RD" /> Their name was revealed along with the location of their homeworld in Hutt Space when they were mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA" />
